critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:16270-16283 — allowed_phase4_statuses tuple + current_phase >= 4 fallback is a clean two-tier gate. The tuple is inlined and short (4 values); if the workflow adds a 5th status the tuple grows in one place. Fallback uses int(procedure.get('current_phase') or 0) → safe against None/missing.

backend/server.py:16332-16343 — scan_* fields use the same null-on-switch pattern as conventional_tray_type / impression_material (iter-191/192). Guarantees no stale data if the user flips impression_type back and forth. `[s.strip() for s in (data.scan_body_types or [])]` is safe against None and echoes empty lists as [].

backend/server.py:14585-14599 — _bullet_list closure is defined inside the intraoral_scans branch so it can't leak into the conventional path. Guards against empty/None `values` at L14587 and empty strings at L14594. Bullet character '-' + safe() wrapping avoids fpdf UnicodeEncodeError.

backend/server.py:744-775 — Stage2ProstheticSubmit adds three Optional[List[str]] fields with no default (=None). Pydantic will accept omitted / null / empty-list / string-list. No max_length constraint on list length, which is fine for the 3-option-each chip UI.

submit-stage2-prosthetic/[id].tsx:139-164 — auto-seed logic is well-ordered: (1) prefer phase4_step1_data if any prior save; (2) fall back to phase2 MUA only when Phase 2 recorded MUA=yes AND details is non-empty. `confirmed:false` on the phase2 seed correctly forces re-confirmation on first render.

submit-stage2-prosthetic/[id].tsx:295-297 — confirmed flag persists via buildPayload; combined with hydrate at :149 (`confirmed: !!r?.confirmed`) the round-trip is a boolean cast → no truthy-but-not-true drift.

submit-stage2-prosthetic/[id].tsx:333-344 — Lab Slip guard runs AFTER validateForm() and BEFORE api.post. Correct ordering: user still gets 'Missing X' first if the form is incomplete, then the MUA confirm guard, then persistence. The pluralisation ('row is'/'rows are') is a nice UX touch.

submit-stage2-prosthetic/[id].tsx:630-669 — impression_type gate + testID prefix normalisation (`opt.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-').toLowerCase()`) produces the exact testIDs asked for (peek/metal/hybrid, vertical-scan-body/horizontal-scan-bodies--flags-/photogrammetry, abutment-multiunit-level/implant-level). Chip active state toggles via array include/exclude — supports true multi-select.
submit-stage2-prosthetic/[id].tsx:166-170 — hydrate uses Array.isArray guard so a server response with scan_* = null (post-switch to conventional) resets local state to [] instead of throwing.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects. Only observation: Alert.alert() in this react-native-web build does not render a visible modal in the browser (neither native dialog nor DOM-injected component was found after the tap on `phase4-step1-generate-lab-slip` with unconfirmed rows). If product wants a first-class visual confirm-block, consider replacing Alert.alert with a custom Modal (RN's Modal or a react-native-paper Dialog). This is a legacy react-native-web limitation, not a Chunk G regression — Alert.alert works on iOS/Android/Expo Go.
